title.sr: Senzorno opterećenje i prostori za decu

aim.en: You can design inclusive play and outdoor spaces for neurodivergent children and adults (James 2022, Kelly 2025), drawing acoustic, visual, and tactile zoning with quiet retreat spaces.
aim.sr: Umeš da projektuješ inkluzivna igrališta i otvorene prostore za neurodivergentnu decu i odrasle (James 2022, Kelly 2025), crtajući zvučno, vizuelno i taktilno zoniranje sa prostorima za smirenje.

bring.en: Read articles James 2022 and Kelly 2025 from the course archive; 1:100 site plan, coloured pencils.
bring.sr: Pročitani radovi James 2022 i Kelly 2025 iz baze predmeta; situacija 1:100, drvene bojice.

text.en: Designing for neurodiversity and sensory clarity
text.sr: Projektovanje za neurodivergentnost i čulnu jasnoću

text.en: Inclusive design goes far beyond ramps. Neurodivergent users and children with sensory sensitivities need predictability, acoustic buffering, gradual transitions, and quiet retreat pockets that remain safe and reachable.
text.sr: Inkluzivni dizajn ide daleko iznad rampi. Neurodivergentni korisnici i deca sa čulnom preosetljivošću traže predvidljivost prostora, zvučno prigušenje, postepene prelaze i mirna mesta za povlačenje koja ostaju sigurna i pristupačna.

text.en: A retreat space must be a sanctuary within the play environment, not an exile outside of it.
text.sr: Mesto za povlačenje mora biti utočište unutar prostora za igru, a ne izgnanstvo van njega.

blocks.source: Kelly et al., Let's Play: Co-designing inclusive school playgrounds with neurodivergent children (2025)

items.en: How can a user anticipate what noise or visual level awaits them around the next corner?
items.sr: Kako korisnik može unapred da prepozna koliki ga nivo buke ili vizuelnih nadražaja čeka iza sledećeg ugla?
